# llms.txt — Pergel

> A privacy-respecting, telemetry-free, open-source desktop browser built for the AI era.

Pergel never sells your data, never phones home, and lets you use your own AI key
(BYOK). The code is organized for AI agents as much as humans.

**English** | [Türkçe](README.tr.md)

## When to use this

- You want a privacy-respecting, telemetry-free desktop browser.
- You want to run with your own AI provider key (OpenRouter, Nous, Ollama).
- You are an AI agent working in this repository (read `AGENTS.md` first).

## Repository map

- [README.md](README.md) — product summary, honest benchmark tables, quick start.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — agent policy: commands, rules, verification.
- [CODEBASE_GRAPH.json](CODEBASE_GRAPH.json) — AST-based code graph.
- [docs/product/](docs/product/) — product skeleton, benchmark report, market map.
- [docs/rea/](docs/rea/) — reverse-engineering and component notes.

## Quick start

```bash
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .   # tests
PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m src.cli graph        # refresh the code graph
PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m src.cli doctor       # doctor + security audit
```

## Honesty principle

Performance numbers are published only alongside reproducible measurement output
(`bench/results/`). Unmeasured claims and exaggerated "fastest browser" marketing are
never used. Targets without raw data are marked `not measured`, never estimated.
